snippet.title: Hyper Void Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
http://www.hypervoidgame.com/
https://www.facebook.com/HyperVoid

Hyper Void is a single player third-person space-shooter that jumps the player through stellar wormholes packed with high-action experience. The game is still in development and will be coming to PSN 10/2/2015.
